run_preprocess_ef: run the preprocess_ef script to create LMDB files from extxyz trajectory files for the S2EF task
run_preprocess_ef_with_edges: run preprocess_ef with --get-edges to store edge indices in LMDB for graph feature extraction
run_preprocess_ef_test_data: run preprocess_ef with --test-data flag to process test data without energy and force labels
run_preprocess_ef_ref_energy: run preprocess_ef with --ref-energy to subtract reference energies from trajectory frame energies
run_preprocess_ef_multi_worker: run preprocess_ef with --num-workers to parallelize LMDB feature extraction across multiple processes
